_comment: run_27 = run_25 (ideal-free settlement, block 3) + CROWDING DEPARTURE ARM (dispersal_departure.crowding_arm): departure logit gains beta_hi * softplus(5 (N/K - 1)) / 5, beta_hi ~ HalfNormal(4), on top of the existing free-sign slope (the low-density arm).

Why: E008/E012 -- the single slope went to -8 (sparse cells empty out) and so gave ZERO departure above K, while 20-50% of birds sit above K in established regions (51% in the post-epizootic east). A crowded patch should send pulses; the one-slope curve cannot express both ends.
